dissent: Implement `staged_object_self_valid` (~:136) requires every nonempty staged object to pass checked_payload+signature; q_domain.candidate stage variants (signature/owner/domain/inventory/head/content) produce invalid-yet-reachable staged objects, so this could false-positive on broader corpora. Within boundary-01's plain-'stage' corpus it is vacuous; defensible as strictness but conflates staged validity with selection authority.
run_controls counts verdict 'unproved' as detected (status!='supported'), lenient; however the skip-chain mutant truly yields 'supported', so finding 2 stands as real non-discrimination.

Its registered target experiments/v3/swarm-research-20260911-155142/obligation_checks/selection_authority.py is depth-4 (parents[4]==repo root; control-build.py:28 correctly uses parents[4]). parents[3] resolves to `<root>/experiments`, so both sys.path.inserts (:48-49) become `<root>/experiments/experiments/v3/cut-source-overnight/batch-0{5,6}` and `import semantic`/`import adapter_traces` (:51-52) raise ModuleNotFoundError. Missing authority chain in implement: the obligation (control-build docstring :6-8) requires attestation->staged_source->selected_source validity; s_inclusive.py tail and s_audit.py delegate block set staged_source=attestation at stage and selected_source=staged_source at commit (same in a_inclusive.py:20-22, a_audit.py:30-33). `_authority` (~implement.py:89-139) checks only selected_source shape plus ssrc[2]==sel.cut; `_prefix_audit` (~:176-208) adds journal exactness/refusal stability but never compares staged_source to attestation nor selected_source to pre-commit staged_source. Fixture: sibling control 'skipped-staged-source-chain' (control-build _e_skip_staged ~:210) blanks staged_source at the stage prefix on BOTH sides; journal stays equal, selected_source still binds selected.cut, witnesses hold -> implement returns 'supported', so run_controls records detected=False. Control-build's own _chain_faults (:101-120) does discriminate ('selected-source-not-staged'). Fix: add per-prefix chain predicates mirroring _chain_faults.

Implement skips initial-state revalidation: check.py audit_case re-runs sc.initialization(ss[0]) and audit.initialization(aa[0]) after restore; _inspect_case (~:211) does neither, and no predicate validates `attestation` shape. Fixture: a case whose initial journal carries attestation=(gen,rev,'bogus-cut') identically on both sides replays cleanly, journal_fields_exact passes, and 'supported' remains reachable. Fix: re-run both original initialization audits (or equivalent shape assertions) on prefix 0.

Control-build _replay (:37-56) is weaker than the adapter_traces.restore it mirrors: no occurrence-uniqueness, requires-order, done-mask or adapter Q-invocation-mask checks, and zip silently drops surplus events; source/adapter action equality and decision equality are never compared (implement checks both). Unguarded `v[...]`/`row[0].request` indexing raises on malformed rows instead of faulting. Fix: delegate to t.restore and add action/decision equality.
